flagged_items.title: SF Rent Board Housing Inventory License Status (§ 37.15)
flagged_items.reason: Public lookup on portal.sfrb.org requires street address/APN, withheld for strict privacy. Unlicensed annual/banked increases are null and void under Rules § 13.14.

flagged_items.title: Unit 1 April 1, 2026 Agreement Structure & § 6.14 Reservation Notice
flagged_items.reason: Must verify whether April 1, 2026 signed a new 12-month fixed-term lease (barring increases before April 1, 2027) or a month-to-month addendum, and whether a written § 6.14 notice was served on Tenant 1D within 60 days.

flagged_items.title: Unit 2 Post-2019 Rent Increase Ledger & March–May 2027 Anniversary Forfeiture Trap
flagged_items.reason: Internal record states June 1, 2019 @ $3,150/mo without certifying zero post-2019 increases. Changing Unit 2's anniversary to March 1–May 31, 2027 permanently forfeits the June 1, 2026 (1.6%) skipped increase.
